definitions.gloss: denial of permission; refusal of an application
definitions.explanation: An official decision not to grant permission for something applied for — a visa, a building permit, a licence. The formal counterpart of {許可|きょか}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{不許可|ふきょか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
{不許可|ふきょか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{求|もと}めた→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: We requested the reason for the denial in writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{不許可|ふきょか}になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えて→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧⟦{申請|しんせい}すれば→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you are denied once, the application may go through if you put the paperwork in order and reapply.

notes:
The negative prefix {不|ふ} plus ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧ (permission). Appears mainly in administrative and legal writing; in speech people say ⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{下|お}りなかった.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不許可|ふきょか}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧: a formal disposition of denial
- {不許可|ふきょか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be denied
- {不許可|ふきょか}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: notice of denial

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{却下|きゃっか}→却下：05908_kyakka⟧: dismissal — rejecting an application without examining its merits
- ⟦{否認|ひにん}→否認：11961_hinin⟧: denial — refusing to acknowledge a fact or claim, not a permission decision
